pre_opening_check.meaning: No recorded reserve opening under the frozen runner at this check; does not imply the public manuscript or aggregate prior art was never seen.

authority: Existing final_reserve/protocol.txt and metadata_scope_addendum.txt control the experiment. This document only constrains reporting; it changes no frozen protocol, code, input, model, contrast, cutoff or number.

representations.independence: Three encodings/transcriptions share one manuscript and historical transcription dependencies; ten contrasts also share data, baselines and model components. They are not ten independent language tests.

contrasts.can_support: 固定页级 H、位置与全局混合在同目标上改善条件词形预测。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不证明手数、真实作者身份、语言/章节因果；原 H 口径并非完整逐行书手控制。

contrasts.can_support: 前词末单位对固定非重叠内部目标的额外预测价值。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不是语法、互信息值、词义或跨行结论；共享续写相消不免除完整成本。

contrasts.can_support: 付清前缀成本后的段首因子优于原冻结位置混合。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不证明高杆字形语义/因果；段首标签可能受醒目首字形影响。

contrasts.can_support: 已付费的特定高杆因子相对已选任意首单位因子的预测比较。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不证明历史高杆机制；不是把高杆单独加入同容量模型的无条件因果效应。

contrasts.can_support: 固定合法过去上下文的单编辑复制混合对预测有帮助。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不是历史复制算法真实似然，更不能确定作者抄写机制或排除语言。

contrasts.can_support: 相同源窗口下编辑模型与精确复制模型的条件预测比较。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不能解释为纯编辑路径单因素因果效应；模型保留各自既定混合/参数。

contrasts.can_support: 同源窗口约定下两种已选 H/HV 观察器的预测差。
contrasts.cannot_support: H/HV 的 rho/权重各自 dev 选择；不是严格仅开关 V 的单参数消融，也不证实上一行像素位置复制。

contrasts.can_support: 付清可逆恢复费用后的参数共享方案有无预测收益。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不证明 f/p 同音、同值、历史异体或语义；恢复模型增加容量/选择预算。

contrasts.can_support: 付清可逆恢复费用后的参数共享方案有无预测收益。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不证明 k/t 同音、同值、历史异体或语义；须保留全局恢复敏感性。

contrasts.can_support: 两个预定合并同时应用并支付原字形恢复的预测成本比较。
contrasts.cannot_support: 不证明两字对成立，也不能把合并流较低熵单独写成优势。

score_scope.orientation: Positive = before-model cost minus after-model cost; negative favors before model on these targets.
score_scope.unit: bits per retained original normalized complete nonempty word
score_scope.comparability: Pair every comparison on identical target coordinates and word identities within its representation. All-word, interior-pair and paragraph-first populations must never be ranked by their absolute losses. Different representations need not have identical words or units.
score_scope.costs: Include EOS, nonempty normalization where appropriate, finite-universe target identity escape, and allograph restoration exactly once under the frozen implementation. Metadata/layout is supplied and its transmission cost is excluded.
score_scope.components: For allograph show quotient/restoration/escape/complete costs, all nine global-only restoration sensitivities, and raw baseline; quotient-only entropy is not a valid win.
score_scope.capacity: Candidate models may have different capacities and tuning budgets. In particular raw and quotient-plus-restoration models are not capacity matched. Held-out score improvement does not identify phonetics, semantics or historical generation.

aggregation.main: mean paired word gain within eligible page, then equal eligible-page mean within leaf, then equal eligible-leaf mean
required: excluded or missing slots and structurally ineligible populations

eligible_leaf_edge_cases.one: Mean only; no confidence interval or leave-one-leaf-out range.

uncertainty.method: Frozen whole-leaf percentile bootstrap, linear quantiles, same indices for matching representation/eligible-leaf sets.
uncertainty.interpretation: Nominal family tail allocation, not guaranteed exact simultaneous coverage. At most 11 leaves with possible within-book dependence; 99,999 draws do not create independent leaves. Report all intervals as generated, including wide or cross-zero intervals.
prohibitions: No interval crossing zero may be called equivalence, disappearance or no effect.
A positive/significant contrast and a second non-significant contrast do not demonstrate a difference between them.
No selective easier interval or preferred representation for a cross-representation claim.
Bootstrap tail fractions are not null-hypothesis p-values or probabilities that a hypothesis is true.
No new threshold or rule that crossing a boundary establishes language, allography or historical copying.

position_auxiliary.family_adjustment: Holm over all six reference tail areas
position_auxiliary.intervention: Permute eligible word identities within each past source line and its exact-length or coarse-length stratum; one shared permutation per source line. Keep targets, horizontal channel, slots and missing values fixed.
report: raw reference Monte Carlo tail area
actual identity movement and changed-source-set rates
position_auxiliary.interpretation: V-only conditional channel intervention; exchangeability assumption is limited to that scheme. It is not a coherent random permutation of actual text or proof/disproof of historical copying. Do not merge its tail areas with bootstrap intervals.

exposure_sensitivity.scope: Descriptive fixed omission only, with per-leaf means; no replacement primary outcome, new selection or second attempt at a positive test. Prior anchors, default seeds and full-book aggregates mean not wholly blind.

report: original page-H and explicit inline-H costs/gains
metadata_sensitivity.scope: Additive descriptive robustness. Does not replace primary results or retroactively reinterpret @ as a real additional scribe.

completion_language: Incomplete work remains incomplete; publish negative, missing and sensitivity outcomes. Numerical reproduction confirms the specified calculations, not the manuscript language or a decipherment.
new_computations: None; file existence checks and hashes of method documents/code only.
